description: This file defines interfaces, notifiers, and data structures for the RLC (Radio Link Control) entity in a wireless communication protocol stack, specifically for the transmit (tx) side. It includes classes and structs for handling SDUs, buffer states, and communication between upper and lower layers within the RLC protocol implementation.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_data_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layers to pass SDUs into the RLC transmit entity and to discard SDUs based on PDCP SN.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_data_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about transmission and delivery events of SDUs.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about protocol failures or maximum retransmissions reached.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_lower_layer_interface
classes.description: Interface for lower layers to pull PDUs from the RLC transmit entity and query buffer state.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_lower_layer_notifier
classes.description: Interface for RLC to notify lower layers about buffer state updates.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs from upper layers, indicating whether they are retransmissions.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU identified by its PDCP SN.

methods.name: on_transmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layers of the highest transmitted PDCP SN and desired buffer size.

methods.name: on_delivered_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layers of the highest delivered PDCP SN.

methods.name: on_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layers of the highest retransmitted PDCP SN.

methods.name: on_delivered_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layers of the highest delivered retransmitted PDCP SN.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Indicates a protocol failure to upper layers.

methods.name: on_max_retx
methods.description: Indicates maximum retransmissions reached to upper layers.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Pulls a PDU from the lower layer for transmission.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state of the RLC transmit entity.

methods.name: on_buffer_state_update
methods.description: Updates lower layers about the current buffer state.
